fato_historico: 1991: The Italian prosecuting magistrate Antonino Scopelliti is murdered by the 'Ndrangheta on behalf of the Sicilian Mafia while preparing the government's case in the final appeal of the Maxi Trial.
energia_do_dia: The universe invites you to cultivate resilience as you navigate your tasks. Just as justice seeks balance through truth, you may find that standing firm in your convictions brings clarity. It is a good time to clear away mental clutter and focus on the integrity of your path, trusting that your dedication will lead to peaceful resolutions.
frase_do_dia: Truth shines brightest when you walk your own authentic path with courage.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual wisdom and the search for profound inner truth.
conselho: Stand tall in your values and let your honest actions guide your steps.
